meta.name: ai-image-generation
meta.description: Generate AI images with GPT-Image-2, FLUX, Gemini, Grok, Seedream, Reve and 50+ models via inference.sh CLI. Models: GPT-Image-2, FLUX Dev LoRA, FLUX.2 Klein LoRA, Gemini 3 Pro Image, Grok Imagine, Seedream 4.5, Reve, ImagineArt. Capabilities: text-to-image, image-to-image, inpainting, LoRA, image editing, upscaling, text rendering. Use for: AI art, product mockups, concept art, social media graphics, marketing visuals, illustrations. Triggers: flux, image generation, ai image, text to image, stable diffusion, generate image, ai art, midjourney alternative, dall-e alternative, text2img, t2i, image generator, ai picture, create image with ai, generative ai, ai illustration, grok image, gemini image, gpt image, openai image, chatgpt image

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用50多种AI模型生成和编辑图像
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成高质量AI图像用于创意或营销。
copy.tagline_en: Generate and edit images with 50+ AI models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need fast, high-quality AI-generated images for creative or marketing use.

howto.what: Claude 会通过 inference.sh CLI 调用 50 多种 AI 模型来生成、编辑、放大图像，支持文生图、图生图、局部修复、LoRA 风格、文字渲染等。
howto.when: 当你提到“生成图像”、“AI 图片”、“flux”、“stable diffusion”等关键词，或要求创建、编辑、放大图像时触发。

say.text: 用 FLUX 生成一张太空猫的图片。
say.note: 调用 FLUX Dev LoRA 模型生成图像。

say.text: 把这张照片的背景换成海滩日落。
say.note: 使用 GPT-Image-2 进行图像编辑。

say.text: 用 Seedream 4.5 生成一张 4K 电影感肖像。
say.note: 调用 Seedream 4.5 模型生成高分辨率图像。

howto.what_en: Claude will use the inference.sh CLI to call over 50 AI models for generating, editing, and upscaling images, supporting text-to-image, image-to-image, inpainting, LoRA styles, and text rendering.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'generate image', 'AI picture', 'flux', 'stable diffusion', or ask to create, edit, or upscale an image.

say_en.text: Generate an image of a cat astronaut in space using FLUX.
say_en.note: Calls the FLUX Dev LoRA model to generate an image.

say_en.text: Change the background of this photo to a beach sunset.
Create a 4K cinematic portrait with Seedream 4.5.
